title: NoteMetadata
description: Encounter-level metadata for a SOAP note. Intentionally carries no direct patient identifier — `patientRef` is an opaque, caller-defined reference string. Resolving that reference to an actual patient identity (name, DOB, MRN) is the responsibility of the consuming application, not this schema.

encounterType.description: Type of encounter this note documents, e.g. primary-care-followup, urgent-care, telehealth-checkin.

authorRole.description: Role of the note's author, e.g. physician, nurse-practitioner, physician-assistant.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the note was authored.

patientRef.description: Opaque, caller-defined reference to the patient this note belongs to (e.g. an internal record ID). MUST NOT be a direct identifier such as a name, date of birth, or MRN — identity resolution is the caller's responsibility.
